mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_request (employee_id, org_unit_id, item_id, quantity, amount, reason, status, approval_document_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{orgUnitId}, #{itemId}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{approvalDocumentId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.employee_id, r.org_unit_id, r.item_id, r.quantity, r.amount, r.reason, r.status, r.approval_document_id, r.created_at, i.name AS item_name, i.unit AS item_unit FROM purchase_request r JOIN item i ON i.id = r.item_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.employee_id, r.org_unit_id, r.item_id, r.quantity, r.amount, r.reason, r.status, r.approval_document_id, r.created_at, i.name AS item_name, i.unit AS item_unit FROM purchase_request r JOIN item i ON i.id = r.item_id WHERE r.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_request SET status = #{status} WHERE approval_document_id = #{approvalDocumentId}
UPDATE purchase_request SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
